verdict.rationale: AvaTax is a tax-calculation API/SaaS product, not an AI agent or client application that would itself consume MCP servers' tools; the evidence only shows Avalara exposing its own MCP server (docs-6,7,8,13, probe-3) for others to call into, which is the opposite direction from this story's client-side 'plug MCP servers into this product' capability. This axis does not apply to a service of this kind.
